decisions.statement: A status from 200 to 299 is spliced through.
A status outside 200 to 299 becomes an error frame.
A redirect is an error frame rather than a status to follow.
The name a status is given is the error type Anthropic gives that status.
A status this module gives no name of its own is named `api_error`.
A client judges a committed hold by the error name.
The message names the status the message was made from.
A status that splices still gets an error name when an error name is asked for.
Nothing here builds the bytes of the frame this module names.
Nothing here sees a response beyond its status.

definition: what an already-committed response does with the status upstream finally returns
